P.name: Colossal Smash
P.title: Template:Data Galio/Colossal Smash
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Colossal Smash|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Galio
|skill        = I
|icon         = Colossal Smash.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Galio's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is empowered to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|{{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and deal {{pplevel|15 to 115|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 100% AD)}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}} {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}} to the target and all enemies near them.
|description2 = Whenever '''Galio''' hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}} with an {{tip|ability}}, ''Colossal Smash's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 3 seconds. This may occur only once per cast.
|description3 = ''Colossal Smash's'' damage based on its {{as|AD ratio}} can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Galio|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage to all targets hit.
|static       = 5
|effect radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|250|pending for confirmation}}
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = special
|spellshield  = False
|occurrence   = On-hit
|parry        = True
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Galio_Original_PAttack_1.ogg}} ''"Smash!"''
|notes        = 
* ''Colossal Smash'' deals {{tip|basic damage}} to the primary target but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}, while dealing {{tip|proc damage}} also tagged as {{tip|area of effect}} to secondary targets.
* {{tip|Spellblade}} does not get converted to magic damage and it will deal its damage only to the primary target.
* ''Colossal Smash'' applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects to its primary target twice.{{bug}}
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|wards}} and [[jungle plants|plants]].
* '''Galio''' gains {{as|attack speed}} even on non-empowered attacks as long as the ability is not on cooldown.
* ''Colossal Smash'' cannot be triggered against allies.
* Even if the ability hit is {{tip|spell shield|spell shielded}} ''Colossal Smash's'' cooldown will still be reduced.
|yvideo       = hjhtAM4VXfE
<!-- Blurb -->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} Every few seconds, {{cis|Galio}} next {{tip|basic attack}} is modified to gain {{sti|as|{{as|attack speed}}}} and deal {{as|magic damage}} in an area, increased based on his {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resist}}}}.
|blurb2       = '''Galio's''' {{tip|ability}} hits against enemy {{tip|champions}} or epic {{tip|monsters}} {{sti|ah|reduce}} ''Colossal Smash's'' {{sti|cd|cooldown}}.
}}

E.title: Template:Data Galio/Justice Punch
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Justice Punch|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Galio
|skill        = E
|icon         = Justice Punch.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Galio''' {{tip|lunge|steps back}} in the opposite direction over the cast time, then {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location until he hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or [[terrain]].
|description2 = '''Galio''' deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he passes through, reduced to 80% against non-champions, and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds as well as {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for the same duration.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|100 to 240}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Non-Champion Damage|{{ap|100*0.8 to 240*0.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|100*0.8}}% AP)}}}}

|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic

}}

R.name: Hero's Entrance
R.title: Template:Data Galio/Hero's Entrance
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Hero's Entrance|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Galio
|skill        = R
|icon         = Hero's Entrance.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Galio}} guards the target allied champion, {{tip|channels|channelling}} for a short time and granting  {{ai|Shield of Durand|Galio|his}} {{as|magic damage}} {{tip|shield}} to himself and all allied {{tip|champions}} in the area. 
|blurb2       = After a short delay, '''Galio''' rises {{tip|cc-immune}} and {{tip|untargetable|intangibly}} before {{tip|dash|crashing}} down onto the target's initial location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Galio''' prepares to make an entrance, {{tip|channel|channeling}} for {{fd|2.75}} seconds and designating the target allied {{tip|champion|champion's}} location at the time of cast as his landing spot. Additionally, he resets ''{{ais|Shield of Durand 2|Galio|Shield of Durand}}'' passive shield for himself and grants it to all allied champions within the area for 5 seconds.
|description2 = After channeling for {{fd|1.25}} seconds, he gains {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} for the remaining duration, becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, and leaps into the air for {{tt|{{fd|0.8 seconds}}|Estimated}} before {{tip|dash|dashing}} to his destination over {{tt|{{fd|0.2 seconds}}|Estimated}}. Afterwards, he lands and becomes targetable again, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all nearby enemies upon impact, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} 100 units over {{fd|0.75}} seconds, and remaining in place for {{tt|{{fd|0.5 seconds}}|Estimated}}.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|150 to 350}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' magic resistance)}}}}
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{ap|4000|4750|5500}}
|effect radius= {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 650
|cooldown     = {{ap|180 to 140}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cast time    = none
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Allies, Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = Area of Effect
|spellshield  = True
|parry        = 
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = True
|knockdown    = False
|flavorsound  = {{sm2|Galio_Original_R.ogg}} ''{{tt|"Hi everybody!"|Voice line plays when channel completes}}''
|notes        = 
* ''Hero's Entrance'' does not resist allied {{tip|crowd control}}.
* ''Hero's Entrance'' has a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 175 units.
* '''Galio''' cannot cast ''Hero's Entrance'' on allies he cannot {{tip|sight|see}} while {{tip|Nearsight|nearsighted}}.
* '''Galio''' will still cause an impact to occur at the destination even if he is unable to travel the full distance with the dash (e.g. by {{ais|The Hextech Ultimatum|Camille}} and {{ais|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser}} borders and terrain). '''Galio''' will dash as far as he can go, and thus, does not end the dash prematurely.
* '''Galio''' will always dash 100 units minimum, and dash ''over'' his target's location if they are less than 100 units away from him.
* {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Fiendhunter Bolts}} {{nie|Opening Barrage}}, and {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}} will activate at the end of ''Hero's Entrance's'' {{tip|channel}}.
* When becoming {{tip|untargetable}}, '''Galio''' {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroys}} enemy projectiles targeting him.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Galio''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
{{ct|channel|attack=false|cast=false|move=false|items=false, true|spells=true, false, false, false, false|interrupts=death, root, silence, ground}}
* ''Hero's Entrance's'' channel can only be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}} in the first {{fd|1.25}} seconds.
|yvideo       = VpIKl1vDarc
}}
